Diameter of stator bore (D) $= 16\text{cm} , Length$ of stator core (L)  = 8$.5\text{cm} , Average$ flux density (Bav)  = 0$.44\text{ wb/m}^2 , Power$ factor  = 0$.85 , Efficiency = 86$$\% , Frequency = 50$$\text{ Hz} , Current$ density  = 5$\text{A/mm}^2 , Stator$ slots  = 36 , Rotor$$ slots  = 30 , Length$$ of rotor bar  = 15$\text{cm} , Mean$ diameter of end ring  = 12$\text{ cm} , Resistivity$ of bar conductor  = 0$.020\text{ Ohm-metre} , Power$ out of 3-phase, 4-pole, $400\text{V} , delta$ connected  = 10$\text{kW} ,
Calculate$ No-load maximum flux, Length of air gap, No. of turns per phase, Rotor bar current and area, End ring current and area, Losses in bars and end rings.

Calculate the main dimensions and the number of poles of a $37\text{kW} , 230\text{V} , 1400\text{ RPM}$ dc shunt motor so that a square pole face is obtained. The average gap density is $0.5\text{ Wb/m}^2$ and ampere conductors per meter are $22,000$. Take full load efficiency of $90\%$ and the ratio of pole arc to pole pitch of $0.7$.
What are the factors for the selection of no. of poles in DC machine?
